verdict.rationale: Alloy documents a broad public API: a complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document, 134 endpoint reference pages covering entities, events and evaluations, and at least one surface (evaluation warnings) explicitly exposed in both the API response and the dashboard. Nothing states or demonstrates that every UI action has an API equivalent, so parity with the UI is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement or coverage mapping, API evidence for admin and configuration actions (workflow building, webhook settings, SSO/SCIM, manual review), and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Alloy serves its complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at the docs origin
The ReadMe-hosted API reference (134 endpoint pages, publicly browsable)
the warnings section in the Evaluation API response and dashboard gives additional information about what data was missing
Alloy's Events API allows you to build a real-time integration for decisioning on suspicious ongoing behavior as soon as it happens.
